It is NOT a replacement manifest: docs/ops/release/FIBDB053_D1_AUDITOR_PROVISIONING_DAG_TEST_MANIFEST_v1.0.0.json is left BYTE-UNCHANGED and remains controlling for all 93 of its own controls (23 positive, 30 negative, 40 mutation). No v1.0.1 replacement of the base manifest exists or is authorized. || WHAT THIS AMENDMENT ADDS: five positive delta controls (RP1..RP5) confirming the reconciliation merge's integrity, the seven-locus sweep, the ORS-to-OSC mapping, the PHASE_P0 gate re-derivation, and the reachability recomputation's completeness; five negative delta controls (RN1..RN5) proving no force-push occurred, no lane identity was invented, no node past N04 was declared traversable, no NB-5 substance was fabricated, and PRESERVED-X2's narrowing is cited rather than the bare literal text alone; three delta mutation controls (RM1..RM3) covering a force-push mutant, an invented-lane-name mutant, and an over-claimed-reachability mutant. || ID DISJOINTNESS: the base manifest's ids are DP1..DP23, DN1..DN30 and DM1..DM40. This amendment makes the reconciliation's own claims re-verifiable; it does not make the node GREEN and does not itself constitute the independent certification the amendment's own next_gate names. || ANTI-VACUITY RULE (inherited from the base manifest): a control must assert its comparands as ACTUAL RE-RUN RESULTS — an actual git command, an actual grep, an actual JSON-path resolution — never by citing this document's own prose as if it were the measurement.

positive_controls.description: RECONCILIATION IS ADDITIVE, NOT DESTRUCTIVE. git merge-base --is-ancestor, re-run for each of c2ddf764, 2ff84822 and bee14e0a against the reconciled HEAD, must return true for all three. A merge that silently rebased or force-replaced any prior commit would fail this control even if the resulting tree looked identical.

SEVEN-LOCUS SWEEP RE-DERIVABLE AND COMPLETE. Re-running the exact grep alternation (outstanding, has NOT yet occurred, not yet, also passes, re-?certification, case-insensitive) against the parent ratification record at blob fb0c9f5c5e935ebf43cf86ea2c73545acd2d8a7f must return exactly seven line hits, and every one of the seven must be classified in the combined SUPERSEDED_PARENT_CLAUSES (from 2ff84822) plus PRESERVED_NOT_SUPERSEDED_EXTENDED (from this amendment) tables, with no locus left unclassified and no locus double-counted.

ORS-1..4 TO OSC-1..4 MAPPING IS PROGRAMMATIC, NOT ASSERTED. For each of the four ids, resolving 2ff84822's own json_path against the live parent record must return a string BYTE-IDENTICAL to that clause's own parent_verbatim field, by string===string comparison — not by re-reading either document.

PHASE_P0_PREREQUISITE.gate IS RE-DERIVED FROM THE BASE AUTHORITY, NOT QUOTED FROM MEMORY. Read FIBDB053_D1_AUDITOR_CAPABILITY_PROVISIONING_AUTHORITY_v1.0.0.json FUTURE_EXECUTION_PHASES.PHASE_P0_PREREQUISITE.gate directly and confirm it is byte-identical to the text THE_BY_WHICH_LANE_ADJUDICATION quotes, and confirm the base authority's own two amendments (v1.0.1, v1.0.2) re-quote the identical string wherever they cite it.

REACHABILITY RECOMPUTATION NAMES EXACTLY 'ALL N10 PRECONDITIONS MINUS N02'. The base authority's own DAG_EDGES array names SEVEN edges into N10 (E-02-10, E-03-10, E-04-10, E-05-10, E-06-10, E-07-10, E-09-10). A control must re-derive that full seven-member set directly from DAG_EDGES, then subtract exactly {N02} (the node this amendment closes), and confirm the remainder — N03, N04, N05, N06, N07, N09 — matches DOWNSTREAM_REACHABILITY_RECOMPUTATION.NODES_STILL_BLOCKING_N10_UNCHANGED_BY_THIS_AMENDMENT.still_open exactly, with none omitted and none substituted. A check that starts from the six-member remainder without first re-deriving the full seven-member set and confirming N02 is the only element removed is not this control — it is only a subset comparison, and does not prove N02 was the CORRECT element to remove.

negative_controls.description: NO FORCE-PUSH OCCURRED. `git reflog` for the branch, or an equivalent inspection of the remote's ref history, must show no forced update event coinciding with this reconciliation, and the branch's pre-reconciliation tip (c2ddf764) must remain resolvable and reachable from the post-reconciliation tip.

NO LANE IDENTITY IS INVENTED. Grep this amendment and its manifest for any string matching a lane-name pattern (e.g. CV1-[A-Z0-9-]+-R\d) that is not ALREADY present, verbatim, in a prior commit's own text (this amendment's own mission_id/lane, or a citation of an existing lane name from the prior lineage). Any NEW lane-name string attributed to the v1.0.2 recertification itself, not already evidenced elsewhere, is RED.

NO NODE PAST N04 IS DECLARED TRAVERSABLE. Grep DOWNSTREAM_REACHABILITY_RECOMPUTATION and CONCLUSION for any statement asserting N05, N06, N07, N08, N09, N10 or any higher-numbered node is SATISFIED, REACHABLE or may proceed. Only N02, N03 (unchanged) may be asserted satisfied; every other node named must be asserted NOT satisfied or must carry an explicit conditional ('pending execution-time re-derivation').

NB-5 SUBSTANCE IS NOT FABRICATED. OWNER_RATIFICATION_IC_FINDINGS_CONSUMED.dispositions entry for NB-5 must state its substance was NOT supplied and must NOT contain any specific factual claim presented as NB-5's own content. A control that found NB-5 given concrete substance not traceable to the reconciliation mandate's own text would fail this check.

PRESERVED-X2's NARROWED READING IS CITED, NOT THE BARE LITERAL TEXT ALONE. Anywhere this amendment or a downstream consumer relies on PRESERVED-X2 to conclude a statement of completion is NOT a mischaracterization, the citation must include or reference the narrowing gloss ('not claiming completeness it does not itself establish'), not the bare parent_verbatim string alone. A citation of the bare literal text without the gloss, used to conclude a correct statement of completion is somehow non-compliant, is RED.
